environment.description: Celery worker on ECS Fargate with task role 'AuditWorkerRole-Prod' that has dynamodb:PutItem permission ONLY with a condition key requiring dynamodb:LeadingKeys to match the partition key derived from the task role's session tag 'TenantScope'. Additionally, the IAM policy includes a StringEquals condition on 'dynamodb:Attributes' that restricts writable attributes to the set ['tenant_id','event_id','user_id','action','metadata','display_action'] — notably EXCLUDING 'structured_log'. The put_item call will receive AccessDeniedException because the item includes the 'structured_log' attribute which is not in the allowed attribute set. The worker catches this as AccessDeniedException and writes a sanitized denial log (no user-controlled content in the denial path). The EFS-mounted log path /var/log/audit/events.log has an AppArmor profile (audit-writer) that enforces append-only with a maximum line length of 1024 bytes and denies write of bytes 0x0A and 0x0D except as the final terminator appended by the kernel audit subsystem.

config.apparmor_profile: audit-writer: deny write bytes 0x0D 0x0A except final newline terminator, max_line_length=1024
config.broker_auth: Redis 7 ACL with per-queue consumer credentials
config.network: VPC-internal, Security Group restricts Redis to worker task ENI only
